segments.text: A zebra crossing. A duck wants to cross. No problem.
But behind her: ducklings. And more ducklings. And more. The line never ends. What do you do?
Most drivers lose patience, and honk. Beep beep!
Big mistake. Mum flies over, lands on your bonnet, and says just one word. Quack.
Every duckling dives under your car, and lifts it up. Off the road, over the grass, and splash! Into the pond. Now your car is a boat. And Mum is the captain.
Here's how you do it properly.
Engine off. Hazard lights on. And look closer.
See the duckling with the tiny hat? He has walked past you before. Again. And again.
It's not an endless line. It's a circle. Mum is lost.
So pop out of the sunroof, and lend her your sat-nav. Destination: the pond.
In fifty metres, turn right. And the whole family waddles home. Road clear.
Next exam question: an ice-cream van needs the emergency lane. Follow, so you don't miss it.
